tasks.title: Design/config: atomic settings persistence and forward migrations
tasks.scope: Audit the current firmware's on-SD settings and runtime state persistence. Implement ONE limited, provable improvement for atomic updates, corruption recovery, schema migration or validation. Avoid existing agent-owned changes. Include regression tests; preserve compatibility.

tasks.title: Security: YBX tokens and privacy-safe firmware diagnostics
tasks.scope: Review YBX auth credentials/logging paths on the integration branch. Close one demonstrated secret leakage or unprotected persistent credential path with tests. Do NOT change ongoing TLS/network tasks, do not weaken TLS verification.

tasks.title: Resource budgets: heap/flash and measurable optimization
tasks.scope: Benchmark or statically measure heap and flash footprint using available host tools. Identify an actual repeated allocation or memory lifetime issue and implement one focused optimization with before/after numbers. Do not touch agents' QEMU code.

tasks.title: UX: offline/expired session states and reader recovery
tasks.scope: Improve one native YBX account or library error/recovery flow on reader: explicit offline, expired auth, retry and user-visible explanation. Use existing UI conventions and localization. Avoid redesigning the entire dashboard being worked by other agents.

tasks.title: Release QA: X3/X4/X4 Pro compile smoke + artifact matrix
tasks.scope: Create or improve deterministic local firmware build validation, identify actual target envs, compile what is available, document reproducible command/results and bin size. No flash/push. Update only build scripts/tests/docs.

tasks.title: Sync: dedup/idempotency regression tests
tasks.scope: Investigate native YBX progress/session sync and add a narrow reproducible regression covering replay, retry or duplicate events. Only fix verified errors; do not reimplement server integrations, and avoid agent-owned session delivery code.

tasks.title: OTA and config compatibility: version/rollback matrix
tasks.scope: Review version checking and OTA upgrade path for downstream YBX. Add a testable compatibility or fail-safe validation (metadata / version gating), without publishing, flashing or changing official CrossPoint OTA endpoints.

tasks.title: EPUB reader stability under memory pressure
tasks.scope: Stress a native EPUB parsing/rendering path with a reproducible oversized input or malformed edge case. Fix one confirmed crash/leak or enforce bounded memory allocation. Include a host test.

tasks.title: Accessible reader UI: focus, strings, navigation regression
tasks.scope: Pick one demonstrable native UI navigation/accessibility regression (button focus, long labels, RTL, localization or E-Ink refresh) and add a narrow test or verified fix. Avoid in-progress dashboard overhaul.

tasks.title: Test infrastructure: host fixtures and failure diagnostics
tasks.scope: Add one meaningful host-side firmware regression harness/test fixture for persistence, auth or update packaging. Document commands and reliable PASS/FAIL; no external device requirement.

tasks.title: Network isolation: malformed service response resilience
tasks.scope: Test firmware parsing of YBX Server HTTP/JSON responses for malformed, oversized or partial payloads. Add bounds/retries or tests for a confirmed case. Do not overlap TLS/DNS deadlines under separate agents.

tasks.title: Cross-worker acceptance audit and integration proposal
tasks.scope: Review reports and diffs from this sprint, assess test evidence, identify conflicts with ongoing YBX worktrees, propose safe cherry-pick order. Do not merge, push, flash or deploy.
